results.label: p1:alg:centred
results.title: Centered Bernoulli expansion
results.notes: Complete identity on an arbitrary probability space for any finite measurable Boolean family. The finite convolution representation is proved equal to the actual measure-theoretic count law; coefficients and marginals are Bochner expectations. The expansion is over all sites of positive exact marginal, with zero-marginal deletion justified. Empty/singleton coefficients and probability status of every complementary Bernoulli product are proved. A finite carrier represents the paper's finite index set, with count reindexing checked. No independence or arithmetic premise.

results.label: p1:stop:polynomial
results.title: Expansion at the first excluded prefix
results.notes: Full polynomial identity for arbitrary finite linearly ordered carriers. Proper prefix equals deletion of the maximum; suffix characterization and scalar parameter are proved. Generalized ambient structure: commutative semiring.
